pages.title: Quick Start
pages.text: $(bold)Place coil. Ignite with Flint and Steel.$()$(br2)Active radius: $(thing)8 blocks$(). Burn time: $(thing)10 minutes$(). Right-click an active coil with an empty hand to snuff it and preserve the remaining burn.$(br2)Using a fresh MiteAway on an existing unit refreshes that burner instead of stacking overlap.$(br2)Effective against Frostmites only.

pages.title: Safety & Limitations
pages.text: $(italic)MiteAway is not a pesticide.$()$(br2)Does not eliminate Frostmites. Does not guarantee uninterrupted sleep, thermal stability, or emotional peace.$(br2)Infested blocks may still spawn Frostmites nearby, but active smoke encourages them to avoid defended rooms instead of swarming straight through them.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Evaluation: Functions as advertised. Marketing department remains intolerable.$()
A disposable residential coil sold like a lifestyle upgrade and used like a survival necessity. Keep one near heaters, worktables, and anywhere you are tired of scraping Frostmites off your sleeves.
